items.title: Arm Is Up 77% Even As Profit Fell
items.summary: If you had tuned in only for the legal headlines around Arm and Qualcomm, you might assume Arm’s shareholders were punished, not rewarded. Holding Arm from the start of the year would have returned 77.3%, including dividends. That gain came through a period that featured sector selloffs, supply concerns, and valuation debates. If you were deciding on 1 January 2026, what did the available information really say about taking that ride with Arm? Narratives are how investors here put a case on...
